answer: atlas records the branch path under every key, and income clears only when falcon sends one nonce probe whose answer is signed across branches that never co-signed any linked key. Linked means same jitter, route, or verdict under that probe; then every branch touching both forfeits saffron and the newer key starts dry. A first key needs one branch trio; the tenth linked key needs ten separate trios each epoch. Renting one cloud cannot mint distant branches, and each added head exposes another trio's saffron.
